PHX › Examples

Examples

50 ready-made scenes shipped with the toolbox

Every example is a single command — type its name in the Command Window to run it, or open it in the Editor and change it. The files live in the examples folder of the toolbox; each thumbnail below is a frame of the running simulation.

Tip. The Run and Open links work inside the MATLAB® Help Browser. Outside it, use phxex_minimal and edit phxex_minimal in the Command Window.
